title: review: P17/P18 read and search economy, shadow: deterministic repeated-read and repeated-search detection in the Jev tool gate, evidence-pool awareness, action_gate decision rows, read-economy scorecard; nothing blocked
spec:
Facts (Planner grep, provenance repo): orchestrator/jev_gate.py is the PreToolUse gate for Claude worker sessions (.claude/hooks/jev-gate.sh): it reads the transcript's recent tool calls (read_transcript, RECENT_LIMIT), keeps a session state with exact-repeat detection (_session_state, _record_call, _target_mtime, lines ~150-200), asks Jev needed/redundant/destructive on a deterministic sample ([jev] gate_mode sample/log/block, sample_rate) and logs every evaluated call to .orchestrator/runs/jev/gate.jsonl; [jev] block_repeats = false today; guardrails.sh is the only hook that blocks destructive commands. T-0774 declared the gate's Jev boundary (site "gate"). evidence.EvidencePool(goal) (T-0794) holds content-addressed evidence with commit freshness; T-0800 fills it from execute/review packet builds.
Do:
1. orchestrator/read_economy.py (new): pure functions over the gate's per-session call history: `classify(call, history, *, evidence=None, head_sha=None)` returns {"kind": one of "first_read", "repeated_read_unchanged" (same path, mtime and size unchanged since the earlier read), "repeated_read_changed", "repeated_search" (Grep/Glob with identical pattern+path+flags), "narrower_search" (same path, pattern contains the earlier pattern), "evidence_available" (a fresh source_chunk for that path exists in the EvidencePool for the task's goal at head_sha), "other"; "tokens_estimate": for reads the file size // 4 bounded by the tool's limit/offset when given, for searches the earlier result size when the transcript carries it else None; "would_suppress": True only for repeated_read_unchanged and repeated_search}. Never touches Jev.
2. jev_gate.py: before the Jev sample decision, run read_economy.classify for Read/Grep/Glob calls and: log the classification into the gate.jsonl row (fields read_kind, tokens_estimate, would_suppress); record decision_log.record(kind="action_gate", subject=task id, candidates=["allow", "suppress"], hard_constraints=["guardrails.sh decides destructive", "block_repeats=false"], deterministic={"read_kind", "tokens_estimate", "would_suppress"}, jev={"needed_p", "redundant_p"} when a Jev verdict exists, selected="allow", reason=read_kind, mode=[jev].gate_mode) at most once per call and never for skipped/protected calls; behaviour stays fail-open and nothing is denied (block_repeats stays false; do not touch the block path). Only ambiguous kinds ("repeated_read_changed", "narrower_search", "other" with a prior call on the same path) count toward the Jev sample; first reads never consume Jev budget (document this as the P18 rule "Jev only for ambiguous semantic equivalence").
3. Scorecard: `read_economy.summary(root)` over gate.jsonl: per role and per task_class: reads, repeated_read_unchanged, repeated_search, evidence_available, tokens_avoidable (sum of tokens_estimate where would_suppress), jev_calls_avoided (first reads not sampled), and the false-suppression proxy: a would_suppress read whose path was edited by the same session within the next 5 calls (needs the edit; if the transcript does not show later calls at gate time, compute it offline from the transcript path recorded in the row). `orchestrator scorecard --reads` prints it.
4. Docs: docs/context-economy/09-read-economy.md (≤60 lines): kinds, what shadow logs, the P18 rule, what active would do (suppress with a structured "already read at <call>" reply) and why it is not enabled (needs the false-suppression proxy at zero over min_samples), revert path.
Tests (unittest, `import _harness` first; the gate tests already exist in tests/test_jev_gate.py, extend them): tests/test_read_economy.py::test_repeated_read_unchanged_detected_by_mtime_and_size, ::test_repeated_search_and_narrower_search, ::test_evidence_available_from_pool, ::test_summary_counts_tokens_avoidable_and_false_suppression_proxy; tests/test_jev_gate.py::test_first_reads_skip_jev_sample_and_log_read_kind, ::test_gate_never_denies_on_would_suppress.
Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result. Never quote double-brace placeholder tokens literally.
acceptance: docs/context-economy/09-read-economy.md exists; `uv run orchestrator scorecard --reads` runs; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

result.summary: Diffstat matches the packet exactly (6 files, 522+/25-) when diffed 1d64d0e..3420810. Verified by running the full suite locally: all 4 tests/test_read_economy.py tests and all 31 tests/test_jev_gate.py tests pass, including the 6 acceptance-named tests. Classification logic (first_read/repeated_read_unchanged/repeated_read_changed/repeated_search/narrower_search/evidence_available), the P18 ambiguous-only Jev sampling gate, fail-open shadow logging via decision_log.record, and preservation of the pre-existing block_repeats path are all implemented as specced and covered by tests. docs/context-economy/09-read-economy.md exists, is ~30 lines (under the 60-line budget), and covers the required topics. cli.py wires --reads into scorecard consistently with the tested read_economy.summary/format_summary shape. One low-severity note: read_economy.classify() is called from jev_gate.run() without evidence/head_sha, so 'evidence_available' never triggers live (only unit-tested directly) — not a spec violation, just worth awareness.

comments.issue: read_economy.classify() is invoked without evidence/head_sha in the live gate, so the 'evidence_available' kind (and its associated Jev-skip/tokens_avoidable counting) can never actually fire outside unit tests — only exercised directly against read_economy in tests/test_read_economy.py. Not required by the spec's gate bullet and doesn't break any acceptance test, but worth flagging since it's effectively dead in production.
